title: Vì ... nên, tại sao: explaining reasons

segments.script: [EN: Quick review of the tone names — it has been a while.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Flat tone, no mark —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngang] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Falling tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu huyền] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: High, rising tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu sắc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Dipping tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu hỏi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: The same dipping sound, written differently —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu ngã] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Low, cut-off tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu nặng] [EN: Good.]
